answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 147809 Country: India Title: Like female use cream to remove their private parts hair similarly a male is allowed to do that according to Shariah. Question: Like female use cream to remove their private parts hair similarly a male is allowed to do that according to Shariah. Answer ID: 147809 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 364/370/SN=4/1438) It is lawful but better to use a razor. (Bahishti Gauhar, p. 115) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
